stem: Three identical printing machines print 4,500 flyers in 2 hours. Each machine prints at the same constant rate. How many hours would it take 5 of these machines to print 12,000 flyers?
solution: One machine prints \(\frac{4500}{3 \cdot 2} = 750\) flyers per hour.
Five machines print \(5 \cdot 750 = 3750\) flyers per hour.
verify:
r = Rational(4500, 3 * 2)
ans = Rational(12000) / (5 * r)
assert ans == Rational(16, 5)
assert len(spr_answers) == 1 and Rational(spr_answers[0]) == ans
